Name: Sam in my own way
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

I remade seasonal Sam, but I had to change several things I didn't like, from the colour of his eyes, to the ugly winter hat and pink beach boxers, so here he is remade my way, which is how Sam should be according to my vision.
(I took his hat off because it's ridiculous what it would be like to not let Sam's head get cold hahaha!)
Here is both the seasonal portrait holder and the seasonal character.

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url] 

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?


Ho rifatto Sam stagionale, ma ho dovuto cambiare diverse cose che non mi piacevano, dal colore degli occhi, al brutto cappello invernale e ai boxer rosa da spiaggia, quindi eccolo rifatto a modo mio, ovvero come dovrebbe essere Sam secondo la mia visione.
(Gli ho tolto il cappello perchè è ridicolo come sarebbe non fare prendere freddo alla testa di Sam hahaha!)
Qui c'è sia il ritratto stagionale che il personaggio stagionale.
